errors.text: The intervention is an undefined placeholder rather than intermediate-temperature aging, including the distinct effects near 600°C and 750°C.
The material is incorrectly treated as a single-phase solid solution rather than an as-cast FCC+B2 eutectic AlCoCrFeNi2.1 alloy.
The proposed grain-size/dislocation-density/grain-boundary-cohesion mechanism does not match the L12 ordering, jagged FCC/B2 phase-boundary, planar-slip, and plastic-instability mechanism.
No temperature window, exposure duration, or loading regime is defined.
The predicted monotonic toughness improvement misses the observed ductile-brittle-ductile transition and the ductility minimum near 600°C.
No supporting observations or evidence are supplied.
The falsification experiment is only a placeholder and provides no discriminating measurement or failure criterion.
